THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I , Gayantha Karunatilleke , Minister of Lands and ParliamentaryReforms, hereby declare under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the Land described below is needed for apublic purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.

Boundaries of the portion of land in extent about 2.0200 Hectaresdepicted as Lot ‘‘A’’ in the Advance Tracing No. R/ELP/2018/195dated 10.05.2018 prepared by the Surveyor-General and situated inthe Village Damme (F.V.P.71) in the Minor Division of PallePaththuwa in Navadun Korale, in the Divisional Secretary's Divisionof Elapatha in Rathnapura District, Sabaragamuwa Province.

01. Lot ‘A’ - Kumbalgoda Waththa, Paradeniyahenyaya,Paradeniyahena - Extent: About 2.0200 HectareNorth: Lot Nos. 235, 9Z, 9T, 9P of F.V.P. 70 and Lot No.3C ofF.V.P.71; East: Lot Nos.3C and 3B of F.V.P.71; South: Lot Nos. 3B,3C and 2; West: Lot Nos.3C, 50, 49 of F.V.P.71 and Lot Nos. 235and 9Z of F.V.P. 70
Gayantha Karunatilleke, Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
